subject: ADR-235: the mutant ledger is about the code as it is -- a static audit of every runner's anchors and catalogue, and mutate_entry's thirteen days of kills against a catalogue it no longer had
body: The board's mutant gate reads a ledger each runner writes when it runs, and nothing rereads the runner in between: ADR-234 found two mutate_brief anchors that no longer landed while the ledger said 14 of 14. tools/audit_anchors.py reads every runner's catalogue without running it and reports stale anchors (found nowhere in the code a runner could break, the sibling engine included) and drifted runners (catalogue not the one the ledger recorded). verify_anchors, 23 checks, holds it on a scratch kit and gates the real one: 33 runners, 1,185 mutants, none stale, none drifted. mutate_anchors, 12 of 12 killed. Found: mutate_entry had drifted since ADR-170; re-run it read one inconclusive, now fixed and 17 of 17.
